title: Relay report shape: a Tool feedback section every role can fill
boundary: **Not in this slice:** ork parsing or storing the section (the ork slice); filing tool feedback as roadmap items, GitHub issues or `slicer feedback` entries; a new `slicer feedback` kind; a relay-run ledger field; treating it as a finding or gating on it; acting on any suggestion in the slice.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Roles hit friction in slicer and ork, and see features that would cut agent calls or tokens, or checks that code could do instead of an AI call. Today that has no home, so it is lost. The relay contract gets an optional, machine-readable Tool feedback section in every role report (tool, kind: friction|feature|deterministic-check, one-line proposal, evidence). Contract side only; ork consumes it (see the ork slice). Human use stays first: suggestions never change code in the slice.

What the code shows (read 2026-11-11 at 953959a3):

- The run report shape is data: `RELAY_REPORT_MAX_LINES = 30` and `RELAY_REPORT_LINES` (`src/slicer/ai.py:517-542`), carried as `report.lines` in `--json` by `relay_contract` (`:709-715`) and rendered into `## Run report` by `orchestrator_text` (`ORCHESTRATOR_RULES`, `:1361-1377`). The free-text-last rule comes from the `owner_needed` line (`:536-537`, `QUESTION_VALUE_RULE`, `:1371`).
- Role report shapes are prose in `RELAY_BRIEF` (`:975-1022`); no role has a place for tool feedback.
- The bump rule at `ai.py:254-257` names "report shape"; each bump adds a `RELAY_CHANGES` entry (`:260-312`) and replaces the golden fixture `tests/fixtures/relay-contract-v11.json` (last done in s424).
- `slicer feedback` (`src/slicer/feedback.py:1-27`) is a local, gitignored log with kinds `friction|bug|feature` and no tool field; read-only roles may not write and a worktree's log goes with the worktree, so it is not reused here.

Owner decisions (2026-11-11): Q1 (a) one run-report line per entry, `tool feedback: N. ROLE | tool: slicer|ork|NAME | kind: friction|feature|deterministic-check | proposal: TEXT | evidence: TEXT`, free text last, `tool feedback: none` when empty. Q2 (b) at most 3 entries, the rest dropped, counted toward the 30 lines. Q3 (a) bump `RELAY_CONTRACT` to 12. Q4 (a) independent of `slicer feedback`: contract side only.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/ai.py`: a `tool_feedback` line in `RELAY_REPORT_LINES` (`:519-542`) before `role_steps`; `RELAY_TOOL_FEEDBACK_KINDS = ("friction", "feature", "deterministic-check")` near `:589`; one paragraph in `RELAY_BRIEF` (`:975-1022`); one sentence in the `## Run report` prose (`:1369-1376`); a `tool_feedback` key in `relay_contract` (`:685-733`) after `conformance`; `RELAY_CONTRACT` 12 and a `RELAY_CHANGES` entry (`:258-312`).
- `src/slicer/templates/relay-brief.md`: one Rules bullet; refresh this repo's customized copy with `slicer template set relay-brief.md --file ...`, never by hand.
- `tests/test_ai.py`, `tests/test_relay_conformance.py`, `tests/test_relay_roles.py`; `tests/fixtures/relay-contract-v12.json` replaces `relay-contract-v11.json`.
- `docs/agents.md` (`:118`, `:164`, `:345`, `:585-587`), `docs/commands.md` (`:22`, `:24`), `docs/working-with-agents.md`; the changelog entry the way s454 provides.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
In `tests/test_ai.py`:

- `test_RunReport_ToolFeedback_LineCarriesToolKindProposalEvidence`: the `tool_feedback` template has `tool:`, `kind: friction|feature|deterministic-check`, `proposal:` and `evidence: TEXT` last. Fails first: no `tool_feedback` key in `RELAY_REPORT_LINES`.
- `test_RunReport_ToolFeedback_NoneWhenEmptyAtMostThreeCounted`: the `## Run report` prose says `tool feedback: none` when empty, at most 3 entries, counted toward the 30 lines. Fails first: the prose names only owner questions.
- `test_RelayEveryBrief_EveryRole_MayAddToolFeedbackAndNeverActsOnIt`: `RELAY_BRIEF`, in both `relay_text` and `orchestrator_text`, says every role, read-only ones included, may end its report with tool feedback in the run report's shape, and no role changes code in the slice because of it. Fails first: no such sentence.
- `test_AiRelayBrief_Rules_NameToolFeedback`: the default `relay-brief.md` Rules tell the orchestrator to carry role tool feedback into its run report. Fails first: no such bullet.
- `RelayGoldenTests` go red on the text change and green against the v12 fixture.

In `tests/test_relay_conformance.py`:

- `test_AiRelayJson_ReportLines_ToolFeedbackBeforeRoleSteps`: `report.lines` keys are the old ones with `tool_feedback` before `role_steps`, so `nothing_left_running` stays last. Fails first: key absent.
- `test_AiRelayJson_ToolFeedback_KindsAgreeWithTheProse`: the `tool_feedback` payload key holds the kinds and fields and matches the brief prose in both contracts. Fails first: key absent.
- `test_AiRelayJson_PinnedAndCheckCommand_PinnedFollowsContractAndContractIsCurrent` (`:189-203`) expects `relay v12`, 12 and last change 12.

In `tests/test_relay_roles.py`: `:2981` and the fixture loader at `:2987` move to v12.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Tests first; confirm each fails for the reason given.
2. Add `RELAY_TOOL_FEEDBACK_KINDS` and the `tool_feedback` report line, rendered from the tuple so prose and `--json` cannot drift; free-text field last per `QUESTION_VALUE_RULE`.
3. Add the `RELAY_BRIEF` paragraph: any role may add up to 3 tool feedback lines at the end of its report; the orchestrator carries them into the run report prefixed with the role, at most 3 in all; they are advisory, not a finding, never gated and never acted on in the slice; no secrets in `evidence`.
4. Add the `## Run report` sentence and the `relay-brief.md` Rules bullet; refresh the repo's customized template through `slicer template set`.
5. Append the `tool_feedback` key to `relay_contract` after `conformance`, identical in both payloads.
6. Bump to 12, add the `RELAY_CHANGES` v12 line, regenerate the golden fixture from the CLI and delete v11.
7. Docs and the changelog entry.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `python3 -m unittest tests.test_ai tests.test_relay_conformance tests.test_relay_roles tests.test_relay_pin -v` passes.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests` passes; `git diff --check` prints nothing.
- Orchestrator runs: `PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m slicer check` passes; `PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m slicer ai relay-orchestrator --json` shows `tool_feedback` in `report.lines` before `role_steps` and a `tool_feedback` key last; `git grep -n "relay v11" docs README.md src` finds only the `RELAY_CHANGES` history.
- [HUMAN CHECK] The new brief paragraph does not invite a role to change code, file items or run `slicer feedback` because of a suggestion.
